mapper.select: SELECT e.enrollment_id, c.title as course_title, c.type, t.name as teacher_name, c.start_time, e.status FROM enrollments e JOIN courses c ON e.course_id = c.course_id JOIN teachers t ON c.teacher_id = t.teacher_id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} AND e.deleted = 0 ORDER BY CASE e.status WHEN 1 THEN 1 -- 待支付 WHEN 2 THEN 2 -- 已预约 WHEN 3 THEN 3 -- 进行中 WHEN 4 THEN 4 -- 已完成 WHEN 5 THEN 5 -- 已取消 ELSE 6 END, c.start_time DESC
